description.value: Monaco Café is a locally owned, independent café situated in the heart of Gastown, Vancouver, blending a cozy modern interior with European café vibes. The kitchen turns out freshly baked croissants, sweet knots, and muffins daily alongside a full espresso bar and cold drink menu. The about-us page highlights it as a neighborhood gathering place with vegan, dairy-free, and gluten-free options woven throughout the menu.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 20m; rack (2 spaces) at 22m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and corroborates the OSM address (356 Water St, Vancouver, BC V6B 1B6) and phone (604-566-7111). The about-us page explicitly states 'vegan and dairy-free options' and the pastry page lists gluten-free and vegan individual items, confirming dietary options as true. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, and most other amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the website; OSM's internet_access=yes is not treated as authoritative per WWC rules, so Wi-Fi is left null.
concerns: Closing time discrepancy: OSM lists Fr-Sa closing at 02:00, the website front page lists 01:00 AM, and the contact page lists 12:30 AM — the OSM record may be outdated or the website pages are inconsistent with each other.
Wi-Fi not confirmed on website despite OSM internet_access=yes tag; amenity left null per WWC rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active café in Gastown with a full food and drink menu, indoor and outdoor seating, and confirmed dietary options; a practical stop for touring cyclists passing through Vancouver's Gastown district.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About-us page states 'vegan and dairy-free options'; pastry page lists Pecan Ball (Vegan) and Almond cookie (Gluten-Free) explicitly

wow_evidence: locally owned, independent café situated in the heart of Gastown
